title: Full reference reproduction · detailed audit

requirements.acceptance: One composed laboratory with 4 fume hoods, liquid-handling station, solid-dispensing station, glove box, washing/drying station, 5 fixed-base arms and 1 mobile KUKA; metric dimensions, collision geometry and source provenance; overview plus all station views.
requirements.gap: Four reconstructed workstations do not instantiate the whole published lab; A–F figure panels are not a specification of exactly six physical stations.

requirements.acceptance: Run FoundationPose on observed images with pinned object meshes/camera intrinsics; log estimated and known poses, initialization, resets and perception-caused failures. Synthetic observations must be labeled as simulation-only.
requirements.gap: Official FoundationPose has executed on the observed MATTERIX beaker fixture. Original glass passes 0/5 local pose gates despite an oracle initial mask; opaque control passes 5/5. These are correlated frames of one static instance. Posthoc ideal-depth substitution diagnoses local depth sensitivity, not a perception repair or robot-level reproduction.

requirements.acceptance: Frozen arbitrary-pose trial bank; physical lift, carry, placement/release, whole workflow and failures; include pose-estimation pipeline; report all attempts and interval for success rate.
requirements.gap: Prose/caption count conflict unresolved. Existing 2 heat confirmations are not 12 perception-driven trials.

requirements.reference: Fig.6B Liquid Pouring / publisher Source Data Fig6
requirements.acceptance: Frozen 10-attempt arbitrary-pose protocol; physical grip/tilt/untilt/return; independent receiver/spill/source counts and calibrated model-volume; report unsuccessful trials separately from volume samples.
requirements.gap: Three local positives are subsystem confirmations; negative whole workflow still fails. Published nine volume samples do not imply nine total attempts.

requirements.acceptance: Reproduce author insertion-conditioned semantic tip loading and synchronized tip motion, immersed aspiration, dispensing and disposal, plus rack/reservoir setup in the stated manipulator configuration. Verify liquid identity/volume and ordered transitions. Force-threshold or friction-fit loading is an additional local validation, not a published prerequisite.
requirements.gap: Native OT2 motion drives reconstructed eight-channel finite-volume aspiration/dispense with a no-aspiration control. Match the author insertion-triggered semantic tip loading, synchronized motion and disposal; force/friction validation is an additional local enhancement. Figure 3G uses Panda/Robotiq and six-well/two-well labware; Figure 6C demonstrates real FR3 loading. A newer native six-well candidate executes insertion-conditioned semantic tip loading, three aspiration/dispense cycles and disposal; original author station setup and full asset equivalence remain open. The earlier 96-well/12-channel videos are retained as fallback evidence.

requirements.acceptance: Couple native robot placement/contact to bidirectional heater/beaker/solution thermal states and chemical identity/concentrations for all 2000 s. Evaluate trace errors and event times independently; neither replay reference temperatures nor fit on evaluation outputs.
requirements.gap: The 2000 s native robot/contact/online-chemistry run has finished; scoped outcome is reported below. Original author chemistry parameters and the literal CSV Cl/CCCl versus narrative HI/EtI identity remain unresolved. Shadow controls are not independent physical trials.

requirements.acceptance: Same model and source parameters as high-temperature experiment, held-out 40 C heater target; native coupled trace and reduced conversion. No separate fitting of low-temperature outputs.
requirements.gap: A 40 C semantic shadow uses the same native contact history. This is not an independently executed 40 C physical trial, and the original author parameter set is still unavailable.

requirements.reference: Fig.5B; Supplement Fig.4; publisher Fig5 data
requirements.acceptance: Two actual robot-mediated additions with compound/mass ledger and color time series; formation then reduction of iodine/starch color; independently verify conservation, stoichiometry, mixing and timing.
requirements.gap: Source CSV 90 s versus text 250 s and concentration-unit typo remain unresolved; original kinetic parameters absent. A color animation alone is not chemistry reproduction.

requirements.acceptance: Physics-only versus physics+thermal semantics with same scene, random arm motion/40–100 C targets, 1000 steps, synchronized clocks and warm-up policy; report all 3 replicates per size, throughput and overhead with hardware/version.
requirements.gap: 4090/driver/version-port timings cannot be called identical performance replication; performance work follows semantic correctness.

requirements.acceptance: Robot powder pouring, scooping and weighing with native granular contact and mass ledger; compare source video phases; not stationary particle activity.
requirements.gap: granular manipulation has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Two robot arms hand a beaker across using physical opposed contacts, sender release, receiver-only hold and stable payload.
requirements.gap: bimanual beaker handoff has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Pick vial and physically insert into a rack hole; rim collisions, stable seating, alignment error and negative misalignment control.
requirements.gap: vial insertion has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: cuRobo plans and executes beaker reaching/placement within actual fume-hood collision geometry, with collision records.
requirements.gap: fumehood constrained reach has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: KUKA KMR iiwa whole-body base/arm controller transfers a held sample between two modeled workstations.
requirements.gap: mobile cross-station transfer has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Robot rotates physical faucet knob; measured angle affects simulated flow continuously; wash and drying scene present.
requirements.gap: washing device semantic coupling has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Physical funnel grasp, transport and release at requested location with asset-specific grasp geometry.
requirements.gap: funnel pick and place has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Robot places a beaker into the constrained OT2 workspace, collision-free and stably released.
requirements.gap: beaker into OT2 has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Physical beaker placement on scale plus independently computed payload mass and stable load sensing.
requirements.gap: beaker on scale has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Move populated vial rack with contents stable and recorded relative transforms and contacts.
requirements.gap: vial-rack transport has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Physical pick/place of a wellplate in OT2 rack; verify all workflow phases and stable seating.
requirements.gap: wellplate insertion has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Recreate the rack/beaker interaction shown in the original video after verifying its exact action sequence.
requirements.gap: drying rack has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Tip load/unload and aspiration/dispense respond to spatial containment/contact preconditions; tips follow nozzle after attachment, liquid moves only when submerged, quantities conserved.
requirements.gap: pipette semantics has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Trace arbitrarily nested task states, per-agent actions and transitions; physics-derived success and semantic guards must control transitions rather than annotations after a fixed replay.
requirements.gap: hierarchical multi-agent workflow has no complete independent confirmation in the 13-gate ledger.

requirements.acceptance: Warp DFSPH fluid solver coupled to MuJoCo robot/vessel contacts; verify incompressibility/divergence, stable fluid/container boundaries, transfer/spill/mass, timestep convergence and reciprocal coupling actually implemented.
requirements.gap: Independent Warp DFSPH numerical and coupled pouring-fixture tests have passed scoped checks. Original GRID code is unavailable; robot-level coupling, fluid resolution/convergence and the complete fluid model remain under evaluation.

requirements.acceptance: Dual Flexiv pick tube from rack, hand off and physically pour into beaker; perception, grasp generation and collision-aware planning must execute object-relative goals.
requirements.gap: A repaired 23 s UR5e bench-source pickup/pour/return/release run passes 16 local gates with simulator-ground-truth return feedback. The earlier full run failed and remains recorded. Matched full controls and perturbed confirmation are separate; perception, rack extraction, learned transfer and original GRID equivalence remain open.

requirements.acceptance: Use the same object-centered task/EE-action skill on UR5e, adapting only embodiment/interface; physical grip, pour and varied object poses.
requirements.gap: Robot-specific scripted joint behaviors do not prove source cross-robot skill transfer.

requirements.acceptance: Generate synthetic expert trajectories; train BC then DAgger with labels on student-visited states; moving receiver online feedback; held-out scene/trajectory rollout on both Flexiv and UR5e; report seeds, data budget, failures, spill and aligned transfer.
requirements.gap: Original architecture/data/rollout counts undisclosed. Freeze local numbers and gates before experiments; hand-coded tracking is an expert baseline, not BC/DAgger.

requirements.acceptance: GELLO human teleoperation data -> documented dataset -> fine-tuned visuomotor policy -> held-out thin-stirrer pickup and sustained in-beaker stirring with contacts.
requirements.gap: Original GELLO dataset not available; synthetic expert demonstrations can unblock an explicitly adapted study but cannot satisfy original-human-data provenance.

requirements.acceptance: Single actual phone video -> hand pose + 3D object segmentation/tracking -> motion reconstruction -> varied physics-valid demonstrations -> BC -> held-out swirl rollouts. Preserve source-frame to generated-demo provenance.
requirements.gap: Original phone video/tracks unavailable; presentation clips are not automatically raw input. Direct programmed circles omit the central mechanism.

requirements.acceptance: Replay or recreate documented wrong robot/frame calibration, use controller observations for correction, compare translation/orientation residuals on held-out configurations.
requirements.gap: These are reported hardware case-study values, not universal acceptance thresholds. Simulation injection is a separate validation.

requirements.acceptance: Instrument actual command timestamps and observed robot effects; reproduce an over-rate pacing fault, repair to target, retain negative control and before/after frequency/jitter records.
requirements.gap: The reference already addresses control timing; our novelty cannot claim timing was entirely ignored.

requirements.acceptance: Same camera capture across depth models; fit reconstructed tabletop plane, report held-out error, and demonstrate newly revealed collisions affect planning.
requirements.gap: Original image and depth-model identities not published; synthetic plane perturbation cannot reproduce the exact reported result.

requirements.acceptance: Segmentation-derived supervision trains lightweight detector/tracker; measured live inference latency/cadence feeds state-based moving-receiver policy and closes perception-to-action loop.
requirements.gap: Privileged ground-truth receiver coordinates alone do not implement the deployment mechanism.

requirements.acceptance: Auditable agent calls construct or revise ingestion, sim, skill and deployment/evaluation; failed hypotheses retained; a correction/model/skill is actually reused on a subsequent task or embodiment with before/after evidence.
requirements.gap: Manually assembling tasks and showing videos does not reproduce autonomous engineering or retained experience.

requirements.acceptance: Report start/end conditions, tool/compute/human time and reused artifacts for a fresh robot and later task; distinguish local effort from original case-study claim.
requirements.gap: No source seed count or controlled timing protocol. Current work cannot claim these speedups.

requirements.reference: Fig.3/6; official Auto scene and clips
requirements.acceptance: Compare source and native frames by scene topology, robot type, vessel geometry/material, liquid appearance, task phase and motion; keep full-resolution closeups, before/after, unedited native or declared state-replay videos, source hashes and visual inspector judgment.
requirements.gap: Glass corrected; full original layout/markings/material calibration and continuous liquid appearance remain open. No image-similarity acceptance threshold was specified by either source.

modules.title: FoundationPose · official RGB-D inference
modules.scope: Official model weights: registration on frame zero and tracking on four subsequent mustard-demo frames. The initial segmentation mask is supplied. No ground-truth pose is supplied to inference; this demo archive has no accuracy labels.
modules.remaining: This verifies execution of the perception stack only. MATTERIX beaker pose accuracy, camera calibration and closed-loop robotic use remain open.

modules.title: MATTERIX beaker · transparent RGB-D pose failure
modules.scope: Official FoundationPose, identical CAD and five correlated camera views. The original glass observation fails all five local pose gates. A whole-material opaque control passes. Posthoc channel exchange changes acceptance with depth source; all variants use an oracle initial mask.
modules.remaining: Privileged ideal geometry depth is a diagnostic input, not a deployed repair. Real transparent depth recovery, learned segmentation and closed-loop robotic use remain open.

modules.title: UR5e · 23 s complete execution, failed return
modules.scope: All 14 phases executed: bench pickup, transfer, pour, untilt, return, release, retreat and settle. The frozen task verdict is FAIL: source return error 18.058 mm exceeds 10 mm. High fluid capture does not supersede this failure.
modules.remaining: Posthoc quality audit also found 172/2300 contact rows involving the forearm and 14.764 mm relative grasp drift. Contact rows are not independent events. This is a scripted independent backend with a bench source; original rack extraction, perception and learned end-to-end behavior remain open.

modules.title: Dual Flexiv · complete handoff, failed fluid-domain gate
modules.scope: All 13 stages of the 19 s native fluid-loaded handoff executed, including sender release and receiver-only transport. One particle left the frozen domain. Retaining 239/240 particles in the source does not override the failed whole-task gate.
modules.remaining: One scripted bench-source attempt; no matched full-duration liquid negative, rack extraction, subsequent pouring, learned transfer or original GRID equivalence. Forty-millisecond saved frames bracket source departure but cannot establish the precise exit surface; microstep diagnostics are separate.

modules.title: UR5e · scoped 23 s workflow passes
modules.scope: One repaired native pickup, pour, return, release and retreat execution passes all 16 frozen local gates. The smaller tilt and object-space return use simulator-ground-truth feedback, not camera perception. All 400 return-feedback actions were independently reconstructed.
modules.remaining: One posthoc repair, not a success-rate estimate or single-factor ablation: tilt, return feedback and compute device changed. Zero unexpected contacts at 100 Hz does not prove collision freedom at every physics substep. Original GRID, rack extraction, perception and learned whole-task behavior remain open.

modules.title: Dual Flexiv · escape mechanism diagnosed
modules.scope: The instrumented replay matches all 117 archived shared frames exactly. Particle 129 first clears the native 82 mm rim, then the 8.5 mm source-count radius. Independent signed distances to all 32 native sidewall boxes support open-top egress for this event.
modules.remaining: The original 19 s handoff remains FAIL. This is one diagnostic interval, 4.300–4.649875 s; discrete centre samples do not establish continuous, finite-kernel, bottom-wall or whole-run clearance.

modules.title: Dual Flexiv · pickup metrics recovered after output failure
modules.scope: The native run completed 8.5 s of pickup physics but exited 1 during final JSON serialization. An append-only, independently reviewed reconstruction passes ten local physical checks and retains all 240 particles. The original process remains failed.
modules.remaining: One pickup-only diagnostic, not a complete handoff or successful software run. The original log and missing result file are preserved. The slower lift motivates the separate full handoff-and-pour candidate; it does not establish whole-task repair or statistical robustness.

modules.title: Dual Flexiv · complete handoff and pour candidate
modules.scope: Last recorded native phase: FAILED. Independent 240-particle DFSPH with actual robot contacts; bench source, no rack extraction, no original GRID backend. Return control uses simulator-ground-truth object pose feedback, not camera perception.
modules.remaining: Progress is not acceptance. Completed raw results require independent whole-workflow review; original learning, perception and cross-robot transfer remain separate requirements.

audit_clarifications.source: Nature PDF pp. 72, 75, 78; Fig. 4j,k and Fig. 6c
audit_clarifications.change: Author semantic insertion/loading condition distinguished from extra local force/friction validation

scope: Simulation first. The 36 requirements expand the earlier 13 capability groups. Hardware comparisons and unavailable author inputs are identified separately; no full-paper completion is inferred from subsystem passes.
asset_progress: A self-contained FR3 asset and several independent laboratory scene candidates were located and composition-checked. They are not confirmed original-author assets; raw NAS assets are not redistributed.
source_boundaries: Audit correction: insertion-triggered semantic tip loading is the author method; contact-force/friction verification was previously misattributed and is a local extension.
Original MATTERIX chemistry configuration and exact source species identity remain unresolved.
GRID fluid implementation, original GELLO demonstrations and original phone-video input were not recovered.
Published pick-place prose/caption trial counts conflict; the discrepancy is retained.
Published pour volume sample count is not the full attempt denominator.
